name: alkemos-food-catalog-pipeline
description: F3-a — Alkemos food catalog CI build pipeline (GitHub Actions only; never on the production origin). Self-contained fork of the audited openCalory catalog build (MIT code, ODbL-1.0 aggregate data). See scripts/food-catalog/README.md.

scripts.audit: cargo run --release --manifest-path tools/catalog-dedup/Cargo.toml -- audit --input out/food-catalog.db.gz --report out/catalog-audit-report.json
